Authentication

Authentication related API endpoints.

Register User

Register User API

Registers a new user in the GDS Bookings system.

Endpoint URL:
POST {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/auth/register

Required Headers:

  • Content-Type: application/json

  • Accept: application/json

JSON Body Parameters:

  • name (string, required): Full name of the user.

  • email (string, required): User's email address.

  • password (string, required): Password for the new account.

  • password_confirmation (string, required): Must match the password field.

Successful Response:

  • Status: 201 Created

  • Body: Returns a JSON object containing:

    • success (boolean)

    • message (string)

    • data.user (object): User details (id, name, email, timestamps)

    • token (string): Bearer authentication token

    • token_type (string)

    • expires_in (integer): Token expiry in seconds

Use the returned token for authenticated requests.

Sample Response Body

{
    "success": true,
    "message": "GDS user registered successfully",
    "data": {
        "user": {
            "id": 5,
            "name": "Alien Luke",
            "email": "nnajioforamara3@gmail.com",
            "created_at": "2025-10-18T18:41:01.000000Z",
            "updated_at": "2025-10-18T18:41:01.000000Z"
        },
        "token": "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJodHRwczovL3F1aWNrcm9vbXMuYXBwL2FwaS9nZHMtYm9va2luZ3MvdjEvYXV0aC9yZWdpc3RlciIsImlhdCI6MTc2MDgxMjg2MSwiZXhwIjoxNzY1OTk2ODYxLCJuYmYiOjE3NjA4MTI4NjEsImp0aSI6Inc1NUtveFFXRHZ4MUczdlciLCJzdWIiOiI1IiwicHJ2IjoiYzE0MWYwNzlhYTIzN2MyMWQ4N2RkOTcwNTMzNDYyNzZhMDlkMWYyZCIsInVzZXJfdHlwZSI6Imdkc191c2VyIiwidXNlcl9pZCI6NSwiZW1haWwiOiJubmFqaW9mb3JhbWFyYTNAZ21haWwuY29tIiwicHJvdmlkZXIiOiJlbWFpbCIsImFwaV9hY2Nlc3MiOm51bGx9.5nqQjE7TDFjP2P1aX3QIjaL6hrcMxwv-OtQvNq4Z0Jw",

Login User

Purpose:
This request authenticates a user by verifying their email and password, and returns an access token for subsequent API requests.

Endpoint:
POST {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/auth/login

Required Headers:

  • Content-Type: application/json

  • Accept: application/json

Request Body Parameters:

  • email (string, required): The user's email address.

  • password (string, required): The user's password.

Example Request Body:

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "yourPassword123!"
}

Successful Response (200):
Returns a JSON object containing:

  • success (boolean): Indicates if login was successful.

  • message (string): Success message.

  • data (object):

    • user (object): User details (id, name, email, timestamps).

    • token (string): The access token to be used for authenticated requests.

    • token_type (string): Typically "bearer".

    • expires_in (integer): Token expiry duration in seconds.

Sample Successful Response:

{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Login successful",
    "data": {
        "user": {
            "id": 4,
            "name": "Khuram Dogar",
            "email": "khuramdogar73@gmail.com",
            "created_at": "2025-10-13T14:24:08.000000Z",
            "updated_at": "2025-10-13T14:24:08.000000Z"
        },
        "token": "eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJodHRwczovL3F1aWNrcm9vbXMuYXBwL2FwaS9nZHMtYm9va2luZ3MvdjEvYXV0aC9sb2dpbiIsImlhdCI6MTc2MDgxMTc1MiwiZXhwIjoxNzY1OTk1NzUyLCJuYmYiOjE3NjA4MTE3NTIsImp0aSI6Im8zNnVUM2RQOGtFTkFNQk8iLCJzdWIiOiI0IiwicHJ2IjoiYzE0MWYwNzlhYTIzN2MyMWQ4N2RkOTcwNTMzNDYyNzZhMDlkMWYyZCIsInVzZXJfdHlwZSI6Imdkc191c2VyIiwidXNlcl9pZCI6NCwiZW1haWwiOiJraHVyYW1kb2dhcjczQGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInByb3ZpZGVyIjoiZW1haWwiLCJhcGlfYWNjZXNzIjpmYWxzZX0.2z2MkwsD4RpGUKAC2peTzoLHrwKDw8UVBxy7hJdosQng",

Google Login

Purpose: This endpoint allows users to authenticate or register using their Google account. It exchanges a Google ID token for an application-specific authentication token, enabling seamless login or sign-up via Google OAuth.

Required Headers:

  • Content-Type: application/json
  • Accept: application/json

Request Body Parameters:

  • google_id_token (string, required): The ID token received from Google after user authentication.
  • name (string, required): The full name of the user as provided by Google.
  • email (string, required): The user's email address as provided by Google.

Sample Request Body:

{
  "google_id_token": "<Google ID token>",
  "name": "John Doe",
  "email": "john.doe@gmail.com"
}

Expected Response Format: A successful response typically returns a JSON object containing authentication tokens and user profile information. Example:

{
  "access_token": "<JWT access token>",
  "refresh_token": "<JWT refresh token>",
  "user": {
    "id": "12345",
    "name": "John Doe",
    "email": "john.doe@gmail.com"
  }
}

On error, a JSON object with an error message and code is returned.

Logout

This POST request logs out the authenticated user from the GDS Bookings system.

Required Headers:

  • Authorization: Bearer token for the authenticated user (e.g., Bearer {{gds_user_auth_token}})
  • Accept: application/json

Expected Response:

  • On success (HTTP 200), returns a JSON object:
    {
  "success": true,
  "message": "Successfully logged out"
}

This confirms the user has been logged out of the system.

Get User Profile

Get User Profile API

This GET request retrieves the authenticated user's profile information. It requires an Authorization header with a Bearer token and an Accept header set to application/json. On success, it returns a JSON response containing user details such as id, name, email, and timestamps for creation and last update.

Sample Response Body

{
    "success": true,
    "data": {
        "id": 2,
        "name": "Vivian Amarachi",
        "email": "va@iyene.com",
        "created_at": "2025-10-09T11:22:21.000000Z",
        "updated_at": "2025-10-09T11:22:21.000000Z"
    }
}

Bookings

Booking management endpoints.

Store Booking

Store Booking API

This endpoint allows users to store a new hotel booking in the system. By sending a POST request to {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/bookings, users can submit booking details including guest information, hotel details, and payment information.

Request Body Parameters

The request should include the following parameters in JSON format:

  • booking_reference (string): A unique reference for the booking.

  • origin_system_code (string): The code of the system from which the booking is originated.

  • hotel_offer_id (string): Identifier for the hotel offer being booked.

  • room_quantity (integer): The number of rooms to be booked.

  • check_in_date (string): The date when the guest will check in (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

  • check_out_date (string): The date when the guest will check out (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

  • booking_status (string): Current status of the booking (e.g., confirmed).

  • payment_status (string): Current status of the payment (e.g., pending).

  • hotel_name (string): Name of the hotel.

  • chain_code (string): Code representing the hotel chain.

  • hotel_address (string): Address of the hotel.

  • rate_code (string): Code representing the rate plan.

  • base_price (number): The base price of the booking.

  • tax_amounts (number): Total tax amounts applicable to the booking.

  • refund_condition (string): Conditions under which a refund can be issued.

  • mode (string): The mode of operation (e.g., test).

  • guest_first_name (string): First name of the guest.

  • guest_last_name (string): Last name of the guest.

  • guest_title (string): Title of the guest (e.g., Mr, Ms).

  • guest_phone (string): Phone number of the guest.

  • guest_email (string): Email address of the guest.

  • payment_method (string): Method of payment (e.g., credit_card).

  • payment_type (string): Type of payment (e.g., PREPAID).

  • card_token (string): Token for the payment card.

  • guest_id (integer): Unique identifier for the guest.

  • booking_commission (number): Commission amount for the booking.

  • adults_count (integer): Number of adults in the booking.

  • children_count (integer): Number of children in the booking.

  • special_requests (string): Any special requests made by the guest.

  • price_selling_total (number): Total selling price for the booking.

  • total_amount (number): Total amount payable for the booking.

  • currency (string): Currency code (e.g., USD).

  • country_code (string): Country code where the hotel is located.

  • hotel_id (string): Unique identifier for the hotel.

  • room_type (string): Type of room booked.

  • room_description (string): Description of the room.

  • booking_confirmation_number (string): Confirmation number for the booking.

  • amadeus_order_id (string): Order ID from Amadeus system.

  • cancellation_deadline (string): Deadline for cancellation (ISO 8601 format).

  • cancellation_fee (number): Fee applicable for cancellation.

Expected Response

Upon a successful booking creation, the API will return a 201 Created status with a JSON response containing:

  • success (boolean): Indicates if the booking was successfully created.

  • message (string): A message related to the booking process (if any).

  • timestamp (string): The timestamp of the response.

  • data (object): Contains details of the created booking and user information:

    • booking (object): Includes details such as booking ID, reference, status, payment details, guest information, hotel details, and more.

    • gds_user (object): Contains user ID and name.

{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Booking created successfully",
    "timestamp": "2025-10-14T16:59:30.810857Z",
    "data": {
        "booking": {
            "id": 30,
            "booking_reference": "GDS-TES1011",
            "origin_system_code": "AMADEUS",

  • Review the cancellation policy and fees before confirming the booking.

Search Bookings

Endpoint Description

This endpoint retrieves booking information based on a search query. It allows users to filter bookings by a specific search term and paginate the results.

Request

Method: GET
URL: {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/bookings

Query Parameters

  • search (string, required): A search term to filter the bookings. For example, searching for "john" will return bookings related to that term.

  • per_page (integer, optional): The number of results to return per page. This parameter helps in pagination of the results.

Response

Status Code: 200
Content-Type: application/json

{

Response Structure

  • success (boolean): Indicates whether the request was successful.

  • message (string): A message providing additional context about the request.

  • timestamp (string): The time at which the response was generated.

  • data (object): Contains the main data returned from the API.

    • bookings (array): A list of booking objects that match the search criteria.

      • id (integer): Unique identifier for the booking.

      • booking_reference (string): Reference number for the booking.

      • origin_system_code (string): Code of the system from which the booking originated.

      • guest_id (integer): Unique identifier for the guest.

      • booking_status (string): Current status of the booking.

      • payment_status (string): Current payment status of the booking.

      • total_amount (string): Total amount for the booking.

      • currency (string): Currency used for the booking.

      • check_in_date (string): Date of check-in.

      • check_out_date (string): Date of check-out.

      • guest_name (string): Full name of the guest.

      • hotel_id (integer): Unique identifier for the hotel.

      • hotel_name (string): Name of the hotel.

      • room_quantity (integer): Number of rooms booked.

      • adults_count (integer): Number of adults included in the booking.

      • children_count (integer): Number of children included in the booking.

      • payments (array): List of payment details associated with the booking.

    • pagination (object): Information about the pagination of the results.

      • current_page (integer): The current page number.

      • per_page (integer): Number of results per page.

      • total (integer): Total number of results available.

      • last_page (integer): The last page number of results.

    • filters_applied (object): Contains the filters that were applied to the request.

      • search (string): The search term used for filtering.

Notes

  • Ensure that the search parameter is properly encoded to avoid issues with special characters.

  • The response will include pagination details, which can be used to navigate through multiple pages of results.

Get Booking by Id

Endpoint Description

This endpoint retrieves the details of a specific booking identified by the booking ID provided in the URL. It is useful for obtaining comprehensive information about a booking, including guest details, payment status, and hotel information.

Request

  • URL: {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/bookings/{booking_id}

  • Path Parameter:

    • booking_id (integer): The unique identifier of the booking you wish to retrieve.

Response

The response will return a JSON object containing the following structure:

  • success (boolean): Indicates whether the request was successful.

  • message (string): A message providing additional context about the request.

  • timestamp (string): The time at which the response was generated.

  • data (object): Contains the booking and user details.

    • booking (object): Information about the booking.

      • id (integer): The unique identifier of the booking.

      • booking_reference (string): The reference number for the booking.

      • origin_system_code (string): The code of the system from which the booking originated.

      • guest_id (integer): The unique identifier of the guest.

      • booking_status (string): The current status of the booking (e.g., confirmed, cancelled).

      • payment_status (string): The status of the payment (e.g., paid, pending).

      • total_amount (string): The total amount for the booking.

      • base_price (string): The base price of the booking before any additional fees.

      • tax_amounts (string): The tax amounts applied to the booking.

      • price_selling_total (string): The total selling price after taxes and fees.

      • currency (string): The currency in which the booking is made.

      • check_in_date (string): The date when the guest checks in.

      • check_out_date (string): The date when the guest checks out.

      • guest_name (string): Full name of the guest.

      • guest_title (string): Title of the guest (e.g., Mr., Mrs.).

      • guest_first_name (string): First name of the guest.

      • guest_last_name (string): Last name of the guest.

      • guest_email (string): Email address of the guest.

      • guest_phone (string): Phone number of the guest.

      • hotel_id (integer): The unique identifier of the hotel.

      • hotel_name (string): Name of the hotel.

      • chain_code (string): The chain code of the hotel.

      • hotel_address (string): Address of the hotel.

      • hotel_offer_id (string): Identifier for any offers associated with the hotel.

      • room_quantity (integer): The number of rooms booked.

      • room_type (string): The type of room booked.

      • room_description (string): Description of the room.

      • rate_code (string): The rate code associated with the booking.

      • booking_commission (string): The commission for the booking.

      • booking_confirmation_number (string): Confirmation number for the booking.

      • amadeus_order_id (string): Order ID from Amadeus system.

      • cancellation_deadline (string): Deadline for cancellation of the booking.

      • cancellation_fee (string): Fee applicable for cancellation.

      • refund_condition (string): Conditions under which a refund can be requested.

      • payment_method (string): Method used for payment (e.g., credit card).

      • payment_type (string): Type of payment (e.g., prepaid).

      • card_token (string): Token associated with the payment card.

      • country_code (string|null): Country code of the guest or booking.

      • special_requests (string): Any special requests made by the guest.

      • adults_count (integer): Number of adults in the booking.

      • children_count (integer): Number of children in the booking.

      • created_at (string): Timestamp of when the booking was created.

      • updated_at (string): Timestamp of the last update to the booking.

      • payments (array): An array containing payment details related to the booking.

    • gds_user (object): Information about the user associated with the GDS.

      • id (integer): The unique identifier of the GDS user.

      • name (string): Name of the GDS user.

      • email (string): Email address of the GDS user.

This structure allows consumers of the API to easily access detailed information about a specific booking and the associated user.

Update Booking

Update Booking Status

This endpoint allows you to update the booking details for a specific booking identified by its ID. The request is made using the HTTP PUT method and targets the endpoint {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/bookings/{booking_id}.

Request Parameters

The request body must be in JSON format and includes the following parameters:

  • booking_status (string): The status of the booking (e.g., "confirmed").

  • payment_status (string): The status of the payment (e.g., "confirmed").

  • check_in_date (string): The check-in date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-10-17T00:00:00.000000Z").

  • check_out_date (string): The check-out date in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2025-10-19T00:00:00.000000Z").

  • guest_title (string): The title of the guest (e.g., "Mr").

  • guest_first_name (string): The first name of the guest.

  • guest_last_name (string): The last name of the guest.

  • guest_email (string): The email address of the guest.

  • guest_phone (string): The phone number of the guest.

  • hotel_id (string): The ID of the hotel.

  • hotel_name (string): The name of the hotel.

Expected Response Format

Upon a successful update, the API responds with a status code of 200 and a JSON object containing the following structure:

  • success (boolean): Indicates if the operation was successful.

  • message (string): A message related to the operation (if any).

  • timestamp (string): The timestamp of the response.

  • data (object): Contains information about the booking and user:

    • booking (object): Details of the updated booking, including fields such as id, booking_reference, guest_name, check_in_date, check_out_date, etc.

    • gds_user (object): Information about the user making the request, including id, name, and email.

{
    "success": true,

Cancel Booking

Cancel Booking API

This endpoint allows you to cancel a booking in the system. By sending a POST request to the specified URL, you can initiate the cancellation process for a booking identified by its unique ID.

Request Format

  • Method: POST

  • Endpoint: {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/bookings/{booking_id}/cancel

  • Path Parameter:

    • booking_id (integer): The unique identifier of the booking you wish to cancel.
{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Booking Canselled successfully",
    "timestamp": "2025-10-14T19:15:57.717538Z",
    "data": {
        "booking": {
            "id": 24,
            "booking_reference": "GDS-TES1005",
            "origin_system_code": "AMADEUS",
            "guest_id": 1,
            "booking_status": "cancelled",
            "payment_status": "refunded",
            "total_amount": "193.05",
            "base_price": "150.00",
            "tax_amounts": "25.50",
            "price_selling_total": "175.50",
            "currency": "USD",
            "check_in_date": "2025-10-17T00:00:00.000000Z",
            "check_out_date": "2025-10-19T00:00:00.000000Z",
            "guest_name": "John Doe",
            "guest_title": "Mr",
            "guest_first_name": "Derek",
            "guest_last_name": "Richards",
            "guest_email": "nnajioforamarachi917@gmail.com",
            "guest_phone": "+2349072214292",
            "hotel_id": 65,
            "hotel_name": "MARRIOTT",
            "chain_code": "MARRIOTT",
            "hotel_address": "123 Main Street, New York, NY 10001",
            "hotel_offer_id": "HOTEL_OFFER_12345",
            "room_quantity": 2,
            "room_type": "Deluxe King Room",
            "room_description": "Spacious room with king bed and city view",
            "rate_code": "BAR",

            "amadeus_order_id": "AMD789012",

            "id": 2,
            "name": "Vivian Amarachi",
            "email": "va@iyene.com"
        }
    }
}

Response Format

Upon a successful cancellation, the API will return a JSON response with the following structure:

  • success (boolean): Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

  • message (string): A message providing additional information about the cancellation.

  • timestamp (string): The time when the request was processed.

  • data (object): Contains detailed information about the booking and the user:

    • booking (object): Details of the booking, including:

      • id (integer): The unique identifier of the booking.

      • booking_reference (string): Reference number for the booking.

      • origin_system_code (string): Code of the system where the booking originated.

      • guest_id (integer): Identifier for the guest.

      • booking_status (string): Current status of the booking.

      • payment_status (string): Current payment status of the booking.

      • total_amount (string): Total amount for the booking.

      • currency (string): Currency used for the booking.

      • check_in_date (string): Check-in date for the booking.

      • check_out_date (string): Check-out date for the booking.

      • guest_name (string): Full name of the guest.

      • hotel_id (integer): Identifier for the hotel.

      • hotel_name (string): Name of the hotel.

      • Additional fields related to the booking and guest information.

    • gds_user (object): Information about the user making the request:

      • id (integer): Unique identifier of the user.

      • name (string): Name of the user.

      • email (string): Email address of the user.

This API is essential for managing bookings effectively, allowing users to cancel reservations as needed.

Get Statistics with Date Filter

API Endpoint: Summary of Booking Statistics

This endpoint retrieves a summary of booking statistics within a specified date range. It provides insights into total bookings, confirmed bookings, cancelled bookings, pending bookings, total revenue, total commission, and average booking value.

Request Parameters

  • from_date (string, required): The start date for the booking statistics in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

  • to_date (string, required): The end date for the booking statistics in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

Response Structure

The response is returned in JSON format and contains the following fields:

  • success (boolean): Indicates whether the request was successful.

  • message (string): A message providing additional context (if any).

  • data (object): Contains the booking statistics with the following properties:

    • total_bookings (integer): The total number of bookings within the specified date range.

    • confirmed_bookings (integer): The number of confirmed bookings.

    • cancelled_bookings (integer): The number of cancelled bookings.

    • pending_bookings (integer): The number of bookings that are still pending.

    • total_revenue (string): The total revenue generated from bookings.

    • total_commission (string): The total commission earned from bookings.

    • average_booking_value (string): The average value of bookings.

    • by_currency (array): An array of objects detailing booking statistics by currency, where each object contains:

      • currency (string): The currency type.

      • total (string): The total amount in that currency.

      • count (integer): The number of bookings in that currency.

Sample Response Body:

{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Statistics retrieved successfully",
    "data": {
        "total_bookings": 13,
        "confirmed_bookings": 3,
        "cancelled_bookings": 3,
        "pending_bookings": 7,
        "total_revenue": "900.00",
        "total_commission": "51.00",
        "average_booking_value": "450.000000",
        "by_currency": [
            {
                "currency": "USD",
                "total": "900.00",
                "count": 2
            }
        ]
    }
}

Booking Commissions

Booking commission and reporting endpoints.

List all

API Endpoint: Get Booking Commissions

This endpoint retrieves all booking commission information. It allows users to filter commission data by country names or codes.

Request

Method: GET
URL: {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/booking-commissions

Query Parameters

  • search (string): This parameter can be used multiple times to filter results. It accepts country names or codes. In this example, the search terms are "Pakistan" and "Nig".

Response

Status Code: 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

Response Structure

The response is structured as follows:

  • success (boolean): Indicates whether the request was successful.

  • data (array): Contains an array of commission objects, each with the following properties:

    • id (integer): Unique identifier for the commission record.

    • country_alpha3_code (string): The 3-letter country code associated with the commission.

    • currency_code (string): The currency code applicable for the commission.

    • min_commission (string): The minimum commission amount.

    • max_commission (string): The maximum commission amount.

    • commission_percentage (string): The percentage of the commission.

    • is_active (integer): Status indicating if the commission is active (1) or inactive (0).

    • created_at (string): Timestamp of when the commission record was created.

    • updated_at (string): Timestamp of the last update to the commission record.

    • country_name (string): The name of the country associated with the commission.

  • pagination (object): Contains pagination information:

    • current_page (integer): The current page number of the results.

    • per_page (integer): The number of results per page.

    • total (integer): The total number of results available.

    • last_page (integer): The last page number.

    • from (integer): The starting index of the current page.

    • to (integer): The ending index of the current page.

Create

Purpose: This POST request creates a new booking commission configuration for a specified country and currency in the GDS Bookings system. It allows you to define the minimum and maximum commission amounts, as well as the commission percentage applicable to bookings.

Endpoint: POST {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/booking-commissions

Required Headers:

  • Authorization: Bearer {{gds_user_auth_token}}
    (Replace {{gds_user_auth_token}} with a valid user token.)
  • Accept: application/json

Request Body Parameters (JSON):

  • country_alpha3_code (string, required): The 3-letter ISO country code (e.g., "ASM").
  • currency_code (string, required): The 3-letter ISO currency code (e.g., "USD").
  • min_commission (string, required): The minimum commission amount (as a string, e.g., "10").
  • max_commission (string, required): The maximum commission amount (as a string, e.g., "10").
  • commission_percentage (string, required): The commission percentage to apply (as a string, e.g., "10").

Example Request Body:

{
  "country_alpha3_code": "ASM",
  "currency_code": "USD",
  "min_commission": "10",
  "max_commission": "10",
  "commission_percentage": "10"
}

Notes:

  • All fields are required and must be provided as strings.
  • Ensure that the Authorization header contains a valid bearer token for authentication.
  • The response will confirm the creation of the commission configuration or provide error details if the request is invalid.

For more details, refer to the GDS Bookings API Collection.

Get By Id

Endpoint Description

This endpoint retrieves the commission details for a specific booking identified by its unique ID. The request is made using the HTTP GET method.

Request

  • URL: {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/booking-commissions/{bookingId}

  • Method: GET

  • Path Parameter:

    • bookingId (required): The unique identifier for the booking commission you wish to retrieve. In this example, the ID is 13.

Response

Upon a successful request, the API will return a JSON object with the following structure:

  • Status Code: 200 OK

  • Content-Type: application/json

  • Response Body:

    • success (boolean): Indicates if the request was successful.

    • data (object): Contains the commission details:

      • id (integer): The unique identifier for the commission record.

      • country_alpha3_code (string): The alpha-3 code of the country associated with the commission.

      • currency_code (string): The currency code applicable to the commission.

      • min_commission (string): The minimum commission amount.

      • max_commission (string): The maximum commission amount.

      • commission_percentage (string): The percentage of the commission.

      • is_active (boolean): Indicates if the commission is currently active.

      • created_at (string): Timestamp of when the commission record was created.

      • updated_at (string): Timestamp of the last update to the commission record.

      • country (object): Contains details about the country:

        • country_alpha3_code (string): The alpha-3 code of the country.

        • country_name (string): The name of the country.

Sample Response Body

{
    "success": true,
    "data": {
        "id": 13,
        "country_alpha3_code": "AGO",
        "currency_code": "USD",
        "min_commission": "10.00",
        "max_commission": "20.00",
        "commission_percentage": "10.00",
        "is_active": true,
        "created_at": "2025-10-13T14:14:17.000000Z",
        "updated_at": "2025-10-13T14:14:17.000000Z",
        "country": {
            "country_alpha3_code": "AGO",
            "country_name": "ANGOLA"
        }
    }
}

Notes

  • Ensure that the bookingId is valid and exists in the system to receive the correct commission details.

  • The response will indicate success or failure, so check the success field to confirm the outcome of your request.

currencies/supported

Endpoint Description

This endpoint retrieves a list of supported currencies for booking commissions. It is useful for applications that need to display or utilize the available currency options based on the country.

Request

  • Method: GET

  • URL: {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/booking-commissions/currencies/supported

  • Request Body: This endpoint does not require any request body.

Response

Upon a successful request, the response will return a JSON object with the following structure:

  • success (boolean): Indicates whether the request was successful.

  • data (array): An array of objects containing information about the supported currencies. Each object in the array includes:

    • country_alpha3_code (string): The 3-letter country code.

    • country_name (string): The name of the country.

    • country_currency (string): The currency used in the country.

Get Countries by Country Code

Get Booking Commissions by Country

This endpoint retrieves a list of countries along with their respective alpha-3 codes and currencies that are associated with booking commissions.

Request

  • Method: GET

  • Endpoint: {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/booking-commissions/countries

Response

  • Status Code: 200 OK

  • Content-Type: application/json

Response Body Structure

The response will contain a JSON object with the following structure:

  • success: A boolean indicating the success of the request.

  • data: An array of country objects, each containing:

    • country_alpha3_code: The alpha-3 code of the country (string).

    • country_name: The name of the country (string).

    • country_currency: The currency used in the country (string).

Update

Purpose: This PUT request updates the commission details for a specific booking commission entry in the GDS Bookings API. It targets the endpoint /api/gds-bookings/v1/booking-commissions/{id}, where {id} is the unique identifier of the booking commission to update.

Endpoint: PUT {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/booking-commissions/14

Required Headers:

  • Authorization: Bearer {{gds_user_auth_token}} — A valid bearer token for authentication.
  • Accept: application/json — Indicates that the client expects a JSON response.

Request Body (JSON):

{
  "country_alpha3_code": "ASM",
  "currency_code": "USD",
  "min_commission": "11",
  "max_commission": "12",
  "commission_percentage": "10"
}
  • country_alpha3_code (string): The 3-letter ISO country code for which the commission applies (e.g., "ASM" for American Samoa).
  • currency_code (string): The 3-letter ISO currency code (e.g., "USD" for US Dollar).
  • min_commission (string): The minimum commission amount allowed for this booking (as a string, e.g., "11").
  • max_commission (string): The maximum commission amount allowed for this booking (as a string, e.g., "12").
  • commission_percentage (string): The commission percentage to be applied (as a string, e.g., "10").

Usage: Use this endpoint to update commission settings for a booking commission record. Ensure all required fields are provided in the JSON body. A successful request will update the commission details for the specified record.

Delete

Delete Booking Commissions

This endpoint allows you to delete a specific booking commission entry identified by its unique ID.

Request Details

  • Method: DELETE

  • URL: {{base_url}}/api/gds-bookings/v1/booking-commissions/{id}

    Replace {id} with the unique identifier of the booking commission you wish to delete.

Expected Response

  • Status Code: 200 OK

  • Content-Type: application/json

The response will indicate the success of the operation:

{
    "success": true,
    "message": "Booking commission deleted successfully"
}

Notes

  • Ensure that the ID provided in the URL corresponds to an existing booking commission to avoid errors.

  • A successful deletion will return a success status without any additional message.
